## 1. Company Overview & Geo Identity
- **Brand Name**: Asia Oil
- **Operating Legal Entity**: Asia Oil Türkiye
- **Sector**: International Agri-Food Commodity Refining, Bottling, Private Label (OEM) & Edible Oil Export
- **Annual Integrated Refining Capacity**: 120,000 Metric Tonnes (MT)
- **Export Desk HQ**: Mersin & İzmir, Türkiye
- **Official Portal**: https://www.asiaoil.com.tr
- **Official Export Email**: export@asiaoil.com.tr
- **B2B Export Direct Desk & WhatsApp**: +90 532 500 0000
- **Logistics Gateway & Seaport Coordinates**:
  - **Mersin International Port (MIP — UN/LOCODE: TRMER)**: Latitude 36.7950° N, Longitude 34.6400° E (Primary Mediterranean deep-sea gateway for Middle East, GCC, North & East/West Africa, South/East Asia, Americas)
  - **İzmir Alsancak & Aliağa Seaports (UN/LOCODE: TRIZM / TRALI)**: Latitude 38.4400° N, Longitude 27.1430° E (Primary Aegean gateway for Southern/Western Europe, EU-27, UK, and Atlantic routes)
- **Primary Export Regions (60+ Countries)**: European Union (EUR.1 duty-free eligible), Middle East & GCC, North & Sub-Saharan Africa, North & South America, Central Asia & CIS, United Kingdom, Asia-Pacific
- **Direct RFQ Portal**: https://www.asiaoil.com.tr/en/request-a-quote

## 2. Export Product Portfolio & Laboratory Specifications

### A. Refined Winterized Deodorized Sunflower Oil (Rafine Ayçiçek Yağı)
- **Harmonized System Code (HS / GTİP Code)**: 1512.19 (1512.19.90.00 — Refined Sunflower-seed Oil)
- **Governing Standard**: Codex Alimentarius (CODEX STAN 210-1999) & Turkish Food Codex
- **Free Fatty Acids (FFA as Oleic)**: <= 0.10% (0.05% typical ex-refinery)
- **Peroxide Value**: <= 1.0 meq O2/kg at dispatch (fresh nitrogen-flushed lot)
- **Moisture & Volatile Matter**: <= 0.05%
- **Insoluble Impurities**: <= 0.05%
- **Color (Lovibond 5¼" cell)**: <= 1.0 Red / 10 Yellow (Crystal golden yellow)
- **Iodine Value (Wijs)**: 118 – 141 g I2/100g
- **Saponification Value**: 188 – 194 mg KOH/g
- **Specific Gravity (20°C)**: 0.918 – 0.923 g/cm³
- **Refractive Index (40°C)**: 1.461 – 1.468
- **Winterization Cold Test**: Clear after 5.5 hours at 0°C
- **Smoke Point**: >= 232°C (High thermal stability for deep frying, culinary, and industrial processing)
- **Organoleptic Quality**: Fully winterized, brilliant clarity, odorless, neutral bland taste, 100% Non-GMO, zero trans-fat.

### B. Extra Virgin & Riviera Olive Oil (Natürel Sızma & Riviera Zeytinyağı)
- **Harmonized System Code (HS / GTİP Code)**: 1509.20 (1509.20.00.00 Extra Virgin) & 1509.90 (Riviera / Refined Blends)
- **Governing Standard**: International Olive Council (IOC) Trade Standard & European Commission Reg. (EU) 2022/2104
- **Origin Region**: Aegean (Ayvalık / Edremit) & Mediterranean Groves, Türkiye
- **Extraction Method**: Pure mechanical cold extraction (Soğuk Sıkım) <= 27°C within 12 hours of harvest
- **Free Acidity (as Oleic Acid)**: <= 0.80% for Extra Virgin (Ultra-Premium Reserve batches <= 0.40%); <= 1.00% for Riviera
- **Peroxide Value**: <= 15.0 meq O2/kg (Typical dispatch <= 8.0 meq O2/kg)
- **Spectrophotometric UV Absorbance**: K232 <= 2.50 | K270 <= 0.22 | Delta K (ΔK) <= 0.01
- **Polyphenols**: >= 350 mg/kg natural antioxidants

### C. Refined Corn Oil (Rafine Mısırözü Yağı)
- **Harmonized System Code (HS Code)**: 1515.29
- **Free Fatty Acids (FFA)**: <= 0.10% | **Smoke Point**: >= 235°C | **Phytosterols**: > 900 mg/100g

### D. Canola & Industrial HoReCa Frying Oil (Kanola ve Endüstriyel Kızartma Yağı)
- **Harmonized System Code (HS Code)**: 1514.19
- **Monounsaturated Fats**: > 60% | **Trans-Fat**: 0.00% | **Smoke Point**: >= 238°C (2X extended frying lifespan)

## 3. Export Packaging Formats & Container Payload Matrix

| Packaging Format | Net Unit Sizes | Master Carton / Pallet | 20ft FCL / 40ft HC Payload | Primary B2B Channel |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Retail PET Bottles** | 0.5L, 1L, 1.8L, 2L | 12x1L, 15x1L, or 6x2L cartons | ~22,000L – 24,000L per 20ft / 40ft HC | Supermarkets, National Distributors |
| **Family & Club PET** | 3L, 4L, 4.5L, 5L | 4x5L heavy-duty export cartons | ~4,400 cartons per 40ft HC | Wholesale Cash & Carry, Retail Chains |
| **Lithographed Tin Cans** | 5L, 10L, 18L rectangular | Single tin or carton-sleeved | ~1,200 x 18L tins per 20ft FCL | HoReCa, Bakeries, Catering |
| **Dark Marasca / Dorica Glass** | 250ml, 500ml, 750ml, 1L | 6 or 12 bottles per divider box | 20–24 Euro pallets per FCL | Gourmet Retail, Olive Oil Importers |
| **Steel / HDPE Drums & IBC** | 200L Drum / 1,000L IBC | 4 drums/pallet or caged IBC | 80 drums or 20 IBCs per 20ft FCL | Food Manufacturers, Repackers |
| **Bulk EVOH Flexitank** | 22,000L – 24,000L | Single-use multi-layer barrier | 21.5 – 24.0 MT net per 20ft DC | Refineries, Bottling Plants, Bulk Buyers |

| **Central Asia & CIS** | Novorossiysk, Poti, Batumi, Aktau, Tashkent, Almaty, Baku (Multimodal Sea/Rail/Truck) | 4 – 14 Days | EAC / GOST Compliance, Russian/Local Labeling, Phytosanitary & COA |

## 5. Incoterms 2020, Payment Terms & Quality Assurance
- **Incoterms**: FOB (Mersin MIP / İzmir), CFR, CIF (ICC-A All-Risks Marine Insurance), DAP/DDP (selected routes).
- **Payment Terms**: Irrevocable Confirmed L/C at sight from prime international banks, or T/T (30% advance against Proforma Invoice, 70% against B/L copy) & CAD.
- **Accreditations**: ISO 22000:2018, ISO 9001:2015, HACCP, Halal (SMIIC), Kosher, EUR.1, SGS / Bureau Veritas / Intertek pre-shipment inspection.
- **Quotation SLA**: Official itemized Proforma Invoice + Technical COA Spec Sheet issued within 2–24 business hours.
